title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment in space

tellings.quote: Uh but he tried to do it while he was in orbit. It was the first ever like psychic experiment in space.

plain: In 1971 the Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run the first psychic experiment in space, trying to send thoughts to people on Earth while he was in orbit, using the kind of tests made famous by the American researcher of extrasensory perception J.B. Rhine. A researcher who goes by the name RedPandaKoala tells Michels this, without naming a source, as part of a talk on UFOs and nuclear weapons.
